title: Assistant Accountant (Financial Accounts)
description:
Role Title: Assistant Accountant (Financial Accounts)
Type: Fixed-Term Contract until December 2027
Salary: Up to £38,486 per annum
Hybrid: 1 day per week in the office
Location: Birmingham

This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional with a strong financial accounting background to join a well-established Finance function. The successful candidate will support a broad range of financial control and accounting activities, with particular emphasis on month-end processes, reconciliations, balance sheet accounting, financial reporting and audit.

The role would suit someone who enjoys working across a varied finance function and has a genuine interest in working within the public sector. While forecasting experience is useful, the team are particularly keen to speak with candidates who have strong hands-on experience across financial accounting, balance sheet reconciliations and financial control.

The responsibilities of the Assistant Accountant will be:
- Supporting month-end accounting processes, including journals, prepayments and period close activities.
- Completing a range of balance sheet, control account, accounts payable and accounts receivable reconciliations.
- Supporting the maintenance of fixed asset and lease records, ensuring balances are accurate and up to date.
- Assisting with VAT, tax, statutory and other financial returns.
- Supporting the preparation of financial statements and information required for audit.
- Working with internal and external auditors to provide supporting information and resolve queries.
- Supporting accounts payable, accounts receivable and employee expense processes.
- Assisting with the maintenance of the finance system and identifying opportunities to improve financial controls and processes.
- Supporting wider government accounting requirements and providing assistance to the wider Finance team as required.

The ideal candidate for the Assistant Accountant role will have:
- Previous experience working within a Public Sector organisation.
- Extensive experience working within a financial accounting environment, ideally with strong exposure to month-end and reconciliations.
- A good understanding of balance sheet accounting and experience reconciling accounts using an ERP or finance system.
- Strong Excel skills, including VLOOKUPs and PivotTables, with a high level of numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
- AAT qualification or equivalent finance/accounting qualification or degree.
- Experience using finance or ERP systems, with Oracle experience being advantageous.
- Experience supporting financial statements, audit activity and financial controls.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to explain financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders.

How to apply for the Assistant Accountant role:

If you believe that you are well suited to this excellent opportunity of Accounts Assistant, please apply directly or contact Tim Farnsworth at Sellick Partnership Derby Office for more information.

CVs will be screened and sent over to the client for shortlisting, with successful applicants being contacted to arrange interviews as soon as possible.

Sellick Partnership is proud to be an inclusive and accessible recruitment business and we support applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Please note, our advertisements use years' experience, hourly rates, and salary levels purely as a guide and we assess applications based on the experience and skills evidenced on the CV. For information on how your personal details may be used by Sellick Partnership, please review our data processing notice on our website.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
- Finance Assistant
- Permanent, full time
- Up to £28k, hybrid, study support

Finance Assistant
This is a brilliant opportunity for someone early in their finance career who wants to build a genuinely well-rounded skill set. Rather than being boxed into one ledger, you'll get hands-on experience across both accounts payable and accounts receivable, giving you a real understanding of how a finance function works. With a salary of up to £28,000, on-site training, study support and hybrid working from a Birmingham city centre office, this role is built to help you grow.
We're looking for someone with around 12 to 18 months of finance experience who already knows their way around invoices, payments and reconciliations. You don't need to have it all figured out, but you'll be comfortable with the basics and hungry to learn the rest. If you're the kind of person who wants to understand the "why" behind the numbers, not just process them, you'll fit right in.

What You Will Be Doing
- Taking ownership of processing supplier invoices from start to finish, making sure each one is matched, coded correctly and backed up by the right paperwork.
- Preparing and supporting weekly payment runs so suppliers are paid accurately and on time.
- Reconciling supplier statements and getting to the bottom of any discrepancies before they turn into bigger problems.
- Raising sales invoices and credit notes, keeping the sales ledger accurate and up to date.
- Allocating customer receipts and keeping a close eye on the cash coming into the business.
- Chasing outstanding payments in a friendly but firm way, building strong customer relationships along the way.
- Handling supplier and customer queries by phone and email, becoming the helpful, knowledgeable contact people actually want to deal with.
- Using Excel every day to track, reconcile and report, building your confidence with lookups and pivot tables as you go.
- Supporting the wider team with month-end tasks, giving you early exposure to how the bigger picture comes together.
- Learning from an experienced finance team through structured on-site training, with more responsibility coming your way as your skills grow.

What We Need From You
- Around 12 to 18 months' experience in a finance or accounts role, whether that's purchase ledger, sales ledger or a bit of both.
- Someone who takes real pride in their work. You'll be handling a high volume of invoices and payments, so accuracy really matters and we need someone diligent who naturally double checks their work.
- A confident Excel user who's comfortable working in spreadsheets every day and keen to sharpen those skills even further.
- Someone who genuinely loves to learn and sees training as an opportunity rather than a box to tick.
- A clear, friendly communicator who's happy picking up the phone to chase a payment or sort out a query.
- Someone organised enough to juggle deadlines across both payables and receivables without dropping the ball.
- Ambition to build a long-term career in finance, whether you're already studying towards a qualification or thinking about starting one.
- Available immediately or on a short notice period, as we're keen to get the right person started as soon as possible.

What's in it for you
- A salary of up to £28,000, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working, giving you a healthy balance between the office and working from home.
- Study support to help you work towards a professional finance qualification.
- Structured on-site training from a team who genuinely want to see you succeed.
- A city centre office with excellent train, tram and bus links.
- Real progression, with the chance to build experience across the full finance function rather than just one corner of it.

If this sounds like the step up you've been looking for, apply today and let's get the conversation started.

title: Part-time Payroll Clerk
description:
A respected and family-focused organisation is seeking an experienced Part-Time Payroll Clerk to become part of its expanding finance function. - Excellent communication and time-management skills, with the ability to organise workloads, prioritise effectively and consistently meet deadlines
